items.title: Formal smoothness over a field implies regularity of the local rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a formally smooth algebra over a field has regular local rings, and the proof is a 47-line argument reducing to the case of a polynomial ring and then transporting the property along etale and formally smooth maps. It uses the characterisation of regular local rings through the dimension of the cotangent space, the behaviour of that dimension under the maps in question, and the explicit computation for a polynomial ring. Each reduction is justified in the source by naming the invariant that is being compared.
